papers.title: Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages
papers.abstract: A benchmark of 202 repository-level issue-resolution tasks across 13 less-covered programming languages, refined by a solver-judge-repairer pipeline that fixes faulty tests and task descriptions.

papers.title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
papers.abstract: An agentic harness that verifies distributed LLM training optimizations across launch settings and code patches, modeling memory and runtime, with up to 2.75x speedup and transferable experience.

papers.title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
papers.abstract: An expert-curated benchmark of 100 tasks for animating static SVGs, scored by deterministic verification programs rather than reference animations or VLM judges, with 93.3% agreement with humans.

papers.title: LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
papers.abstract: A finetuned commerce LLM that predicts promotion response from transaction data; in a production A/B test it raised conversion by 1% and cut promotion cost by 6%.

papers.title: Auriga Technical Report: A Task-Agnostic Agent Harness for Zero-Shot Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: A task-agnostic harness that helps vision-language models act as robot controllers through 3D measurements, dual-arm control, and execution checks, reaching 57.7% success on RoboDojo without training.

papers.title: Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization
papers.abstract: Two visual focusing losses align ViT attention with image regions, yielding specialized spatial attention heads without labels and better zero-shot segmentation on DINO-style models.

papers.title: SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
papers.abstract: A study of data and training choices for models that jointly predict video and robot actions while keeping language-video alignment intact, using about 47,000 hours of mixed video; weights released.

papers.title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
papers.abstract: A multimodal agentic retrieval system that uses graph-probing tools over a large dermatology knowledge graph to gather text and image evidence, outperforming direct answering on VQA benchmarks.

papers.title: onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
papers.abstract: A two-table weight-sharing design for language models that mixes two softmax output distributions with a token-conditioned gate, lowering validation loss in most tested settings.

papers.title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
papers.abstract: A training-free method that skips computing most upper layers during prompt prefill by predicting their inputs with a closed-form ridge regression, speeding time to first token with small accuracy costs.

cc_updates.body:
What's changed

* Added fast mode on Vertex in the global, us and eu regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it

What's changed

* Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
* Added `--settings <file>` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control`
* Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them
* Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt

What's changed

* Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
* Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too
* Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool...
